inputs.name: hand over from Logging and Observability to Model Performance Monitoring

output.level_0: Logs crash before reaching monitoring, so forecast drift goes unnoticed until shelves empty.
output.level_1: No logs exist, so performance monitoring has no input to evaluate model accuracy.
output.level_2: Manually copied logs feed monitoring, but delays hide drift until residual stock spikes.
output.level_3: Automated log streaming feeds monitoring, detecting drift before store managers override orders.
output.level_4: Governed log pipelines ensure monitoring data integrity, satisfying audit requirements for automated orders.
